allow: PowerShell($procs = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach \($p in $procs\) { try { $proc = Get-Process -Id $p -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output "PID $p = $\($proc.ProcessName\)"; Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -Confirm:$false; Write-Output "  stopped" } catch { Write-Output "  PID $p already gone" } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($null -eq $c\) { Write-Output "8081 now free" } else { Write-Output "8081 STILL in use" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Firewall profiles ==="; Get-NetFirewallProfile | Select-Object Name, Enabled | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output "=== Existing inbound rules for node / 8081 ==="; $r = Get-NetFirewallRule -Direction Inbound -Enabled True -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match 'node|expo|8081' } | Select-Object DisplayName, Action; if \($r\) { $r | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Output "  none found" }; Write-Output "=== ngrok available for tunnel fallback? ==="; if \(Test-Path "node_modules\\@expo\\ngrok"\) { Write-Output "  installed" } else { Write-Output "  NOT installed \(tunnel would prompt to install\)" })

PowerShell($procs = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if \($null -eq $procs\) { Write-Output "8081 already free" } else { foreach \($p in $procs\) { try { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -Confirm:$false; Write-Output "stopped PID $p" } catch { Write-Output "PID $p gone" } } }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if \($null -eq \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\)\) { Write-Output "8081 free" } else { Write-Output "8081 still busy" })
